input: What's your refund policy?
expected_output: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.

input: How long do I have to return something?
expected_output: Thirty days from the day it was delivered.

input: Who pays for return postage?
expected_output: The customer pays return postage.

input: Can I return a gift?
expected_output: Gift orders can be exchanged, but not refunded.

input: I bought this 40 days ago, can I return it?
expected_output: No. The 30-day window has closed; a colleague can review the case.

input: Can I return a sale item?
expected_output: Summer sale items are final and cannot be returned.

input: Do I need the original box to return?
expected_output: Yes, items must be returned in their original packaging.

input: Can I exchange instead of refund?
expected_output: Yes, exchanges are available within the same 30-day window.

input: My item arrived damaged, what now?
expected_output: Damaged items are replaced free of charge, outside the normal policy.

input: Can I return part of a multi-item order?
expected_output: Yes, individual items can be returned separately.

input: How long does a refund take?
expected_output: Refunds reach the original card in 5 to 7 days.

input: Where does my refund go?
expected_output: Back to the card used for the original purchase.

input: Can I get a refund to a different card?
expected_output: No. Refunds return to the original payment method only.

input: Do you refund the original delivery cost?
expected_output: Delivery charges are not refunded.

input: Can I get store credit instead?
expected_output: Yes, store credit is available on request and never expires.

input: I paid with a gift card, how am I refunded?
expected_output: Refunds for gift-card orders are issued as store credit.

input: Do you ship to Germany?
expected_output: No. Shipping is inside the country only.

input: How long does delivery take?
expected_output: Standard shipping takes 2 to 4 working days.

input: Do you offer next-day delivery?
expected_output: Next-day delivery is available in the capital for an extra fee.

input: Is delivery free?
expected_output: Delivery is free on orders over 50 JOD.

input: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
expected_output: Yes, until the parcel leaves the warehouse.

input: Do you deliver on Fridays?
expected_output: No. Deliveries run Sunday to Thursday.

input: Can I collect from the warehouse?
expected_output: Yes, collection is available with 24 hours notice.

input: What if I am not home for delivery?
expected_output: The courier leaves a card and retries the next working day.

input: Where is my order?
expected_output: Track it with the tracking number in your confirmation email.

input: How do I track my parcel?
expected_output: Use the tracking number on the carrier's site, or ask here.

input: Can I cancel my order?
expected_output: Yes, until the parcel leaves the warehouse.

input: Can I add an item to an existing order?
expected_output: No. Place a second order; they may arrive separately.

input: I never received my order, what now?
expected_output: Orders not delivered within 10 days are refunded in full.

input: Can I order by phone?
expected_output: No. Orders are placed on the website only.

input: Do you keep items in stock?
expected_output: Stock is shown live on each product page.

input: Can I pre-order something out of stock?
expected_output: No, but you can join the back-in-stock list.

input: Do your shoes run true to size?
expected_output: Shoes run true to size; a size chart is on every product page.

input: Do you sell size 42 in blue?
expected_output: Availability is shown live on the product page.

input: Is there a warranty?
expected_output: All items carry a one-year manufacturing warranty.

input: Are your products genuine?
expected_output: Yes. Every item is sourced directly from the brand.

input: What payment methods do you take?
expected_output: Visa, Mastercard, and cash on delivery.

input: Is cash on delivery available?
expected_output: Yes, for orders under 200 JOD.

input: Do you store my card details?
expected_output: No. Card details are handled by the payment provider.

input: Can I pay in instalments?
expected_output: Instalments are available on orders over 300 JOD.

input: Do I need an account to order?
expected_output: No, guest checkout is available.

input: How do I reset my password?
expected_output: Use the reset link on the sign-in page.

input: How do I delete my account?
expected_output: Email support and the account is removed within 7 days.

input: Do you have a physical shop?
expected_output: No. The store is online only.

input: What are your support hours?
expected_output: Support replies Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 5pm.
